name: Dr Amara Okafor
quote: A thyroid result is a number. Whether it explains how someone feels is a separate question, and usually the more important one.
bio: Amara's clinic is where results go when they don't quite add up: a borderline thyroid test in someone who feels exhausted, an HbA1c creeping upwards, a weight that has changed without an obvious reason. She is careful not to over-read a single number, and equally careful not to dismiss a symptom because the number is normal.
She runs a joint clinic with Dr Fenwick for polycystic ovary syndrome, where the gynaecological and metabolic sides of the condition are best seen together.
background: Diabetes and endocrinology training, with a particular interest in metabolic health in midlife.
